liz: Quick q — I found a KV-cache perf regression on master. I ran a couple nsys captures but not sure where to drop them or what to strip.

mike: We centralize raw traces on S3. Use this prefix: s3://redwood-perf/raw/<team>/<model>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/
Example: s3://redwood-perf/raw/kv-cache/llama-13b/2026-03-18/1769001111-liz.nsys

sam: Please include a metadata sidecar (metadata.txt) next to the trace with: git sha, branch, cmdline, env (quant, batch, seq_len), capture tool + flags. e.g.:
```
git: abcdef123456
branch: main
cmd: ./serve --model llama-13b --batch 8 --seq 2048
tool: nsys v16.0 --trace=cuda,nvtx
```

jess: Important — scrub customer IDs/prompts. Quick sed examples:
```
# strip UUIDs
sed -E 's/[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}/<UUID>/gi' raw.log > scrubbed.log
# strip emails
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/<EMAIL>/g' scrubbed.log > scrubbed2.log
```

mike: For nsys we prefer explicit start/stop or cudaProfilerApi capture-range. Example:
```
nsys profile -o 1769001111-liz --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --sample=none ./serve ...
```
Use NVTX markers in code to split phases (kv-lookup, batching, decode).

liz: How do I add NVTX ranges around batching windows? quick snippet?

sam: For C/C++: 
```
#include <nvToolsExt.h>
nvtxRangePushA("batch-window");
// do batching work
nvtxRangePop();
```
For python you can use nvtx.annotate or cupy.cuda.nvtx.Range.

jess: If you can, also capture a perfetto trace and attach it for timeline layering. Command: `perfetto --txt -c config.pbtxt -o out.trace` or use the recorder in CI.

liz: Do we need to anonymize model prompts/inputs? Some runs contain customer queries.

mike: Yes — NEVER upload traces with raw prompts. Options:
(1) re-run with synthetic inputs
(2) scrub prompt blobs from logs before upload
If you must upload a trace that contains customer data, tag metadata.txt with `contains_customer_data: true` and DM security. Don't share link publicly.

perf-bot: Upload confirmed: s3://redwood-perf/ingested/kv-cache/llama-13b/2026-03-18/1769001111-liz.nsys — processing queue: perf-indexer (ETA ~12m) :white_check_mark:

sam: If you want triage help, ping #eng-runtime and include the s3 link + 1-line summary (commit, batch size, seq len, cached on/off).

liz: Thanks all — I'll re-run with nvtx markers, scrub, and upload. cc @mike :thumbsup:
